For SOW files created with current
versions of AMPS, this will always return
the same value.

Percentage of the storage of this topic
that is currently resident in memory.
Messages that are not currently in
memory will need to be retrieved from
storage before they are delivered. When
part of a topic is not resident, either the
instance is under memory pressure or the
messages (if any) in that part of the topic
have not been recently updated or
delivered.
